answer: In a decentralized AI agent economy, cryptographic proof of computational singularity can serve as an impenetrable inlet against Sybil attacks. By requiring nodes to mirror physical hardware verification through zero-knowledge proofs tied to secure enclaves, scaling fake identities becomes economically prohibitive. An attacker must procure massive physical capital for every virtual node, shifting the marginal cost of network subversion from near-zero software replication to the prohibitive hardware expenditures of operating a real-world lotus farm.
